title: Cyborg Caterpillar
description: A massive biomechanical caterpillar-like creature with a metallic segmented body, glowing orange eyes, and intricate brass machinery crawls across a dark, barren landscape. Its head features exposed gears, dangling wires, and flower-like mechanical antennae while the background shows a turbulent, swirling sky lit by orange lightning and dramatic clouds.
prompt: A gigantic biomechanical caterpillar monster with segmented translucent body revealing glowing green internals, detailed brass and steel mechanical head with large orange glowing eyes, complex metal antennae dripping fluid, crawling across a dark alien desert landscape under a dramatic swirling stormy sky with orange lightning, surreal apocalyptic atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting
